survivors.title: Lintel for maintenance teams
survivors.pitch: Work orders without the paperwork: the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page built for maintenance teams, ends in printed QR cards for the wall.

verdicts.attack: Voice transcription might be overkill for work orders
verdicts.why: Solves a real pain point with a concrete workflow and tangible artifact

verdicts.why: Too generic, fails on newness rule with many existing competitors
